messages.subject: Error with recordTable
parts:
Jürgen, Group

I am getting the following error message - while working on the same folders-images where previously it has been successful. I did add additional metadataTage fields but in this recent session recordTable has processed 10s of  thousands of images from multiple cameras and stations.

The first four lines are part of my script, but the subsequent are returned from camtrapR::recordTable.

  undefined columns selected

My script is 
# with a for loop I am working through project sets of stations

    rec.tab.name <- paste0( "rec.tab.", projects[ iproj])
    rec.tab.name <- sub( " ", ".", rec.tab.name)

    cat( paste( " About to start function recordTable at ",
                Sys.time(), " "))

    assign( rec.tab.name,
            recordTable(inDir = paste (image_directory, projects[ iproj], sep = "") ,
                        IDfrom = "directory",
                        timeZone = "Etc/GMT-10",
                        removeDuplicateRecords = FALSE,
                        additionalMetadataTags = 
                            c("EXIF:CameraModelName",
                              "MakerNotes:SerialNumber",
                              "MakerNotes:UserLabel",
                              "MakerNotes:AmbientTemperature",
                              "MakerNotes:MoonPhase",
                              "MakerNotes:BatteryVoltage",
                              "MakerNotes:TriggerMode",

                              "MakerNotes:EventNumber",
                              "MakerNotes:MotionSensitivity",
                              "MakerNotes:FirmwareVersion",
                              "EXIF:ExifImageHeight",
                              "EXIF:SceneCaptureType",
                              "XMP:Subject",
                              "IPTC:Keywords")))
    cat( paste( " Finished function recordTable at ",
                Sys.time(), " "))
    print (dim( get( rec.tab.name)))

I am running camtrapR 1.2 with R version 3.6.1 (2019-07-05) in RStudio.

Are there MetadataTags in my call of recordTable that are not in the metadata of the images from the station that comes next on from CRLN_MDm02-201611? Is the firmware old and are some MakerNotes:fields not in the image metadata?   

Where is "intable"? Is that inside the function "recordTable"?  Is "record.table" a precursor to the data frame "rec.tab" returned by recordTable?

Thanks
David

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error with recordTable
parts:
Dear David, 
this appears to be a bug in the new version. Even (partially) missing tags should not be a problem normally, but I may have broken something in the code unintentionally.
Would you be able to please share the two folders causing the error (zipped or via Dropbox / Google Drive)?

In the meantime you can use the previous version of the package 
packageurl <- "http://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/camtrapR/camtrapR_1.1.tar.gz"
install.packages(packageurl, repos=NULL, type="source")

My apologies for the problems caused by the new version.
Best regards,
Jürgen

messages.author: 9c3183af58028473
messages.subject: Re: Error with recordTable
parts:
Jürgen

Many thanks for working so hard on my issues. I am very grateful - and amazed at the high quality and speed of your support.

Prior to closing this issue, I note that in addition to your correction of a colon being changed by R within your recordTable function, there is an additional factor we need to consider.

I was using the additionalMetadataTags argument.  This depends on ExifTool making a successful extraction and will usually depend on ExifTool being an up to date version.  I belated realised this and upgraded to ExifTool 11.80. 

Again, I am very appreciative of your excellent support.

David
